status: Native Smart Sharpen and Reduce Noise workflows implemented and tested; full Photoshop/F01 parity remains open.
scope: Smart Sharpen Gaussian/Lens/Motion removal, amount/radius/noise and shadow/highlight fade controls
Reduce Noise luma/chroma/detail/JPEG controls and additional RGB channel smoothing
Native preview at Fit/100%, local Undo/Redo, Cancel/one document commit and editable Smart Filters
Shared Photato filter APIs, observable workspace state, native37/Actions9 metadata and strict older-format rejection

original.SmartSharpen: Original algo/src/sharpen.rs smart() implements Gaussian residual sharpening with exponential small-difference noise suppression only. Additional native modes and tonal controls need genuine algorithms, not aliases.
original.ReduceNoise: Original algo/src/denoise.rs provides bounded linear-time guided luma/chroma smoothing, document-anchored JPEG-grid softening and detail sharpening. Source implements multiple color modes; native RGB/context behavior must be stated honestly.

primary_references.use: Amount/radius/noise, three removal modes,100% evaluation and Smart Object workflow.
Tonal sharpening controls and edge-preserving whole-image/per-channel noise reduction.

Smart Sharpen is listed among tested execute-actions filters; exact configurations require recorded ActionJSON. Reduce Noise is not listed in the tested subset, which is not evidence of an invented dedicated endpoint.

provenance.native_extension: Regularized tiled disk/line deconvolution via Accelerate; tonal fades and independent RGB channel controls are native extensions, not asserted Photoshop kernels.

api.state: photoDetail availability/workspace/preview state; complete parameter schemas and capabilities
api.adobe: Published execute-actions supports Smart Sharpen, but exact descriptors and editable PSD are not independently qualified. Both new descriptor families explicitly reject; no invented Adobe routes.
api.limits: 8MP RGB raster/Smart Object layers; component/auxiliary channel targets unsupported. Selection and locks apply. RGB8/16 encoded, RGB32 linear unclipped. Original alpha and zero-alpha hidden samples retained. Source defaults, not verified Adobe defaults.

evidence.ui: Synthetic hidden-window/offscreen tests; no live desktop or hardware platform qualification.
evidence.qualification: All45 final focused Debug and1980 full optimized tests pass. The universal macOS14+ package verifies after fresh extraction, including both architectures, signature, icon/licenses and optional model provenance.

remaining: Recorded Adobe actionJSON and editable PSD/PSB
Live UI and physical supported-platform checks
Larger images and remaining ordinary filter catalogue
